text_block_list.text:
Awww yeah! It's here, it's here! Today's
the day!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
We've got the aspiring world champ, El
Condor
Pasa, the Otherworldly
Front-Runner, Silence
Suzuka, and the
Beast's Successor, Грасс Вандер!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
You're delusional if you don't believe
this is the
race of the century! I better
not blink!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe! Come here! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Oh... Maruzen! You came!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Of course! How could I miss a rad race
like this?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Right, Rudolf? ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: So, you're here as well, Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Whoa whoa! Y-you too, P-President?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Luckily, Марузенски has managed to
keep an
extra seat empty.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You should come join us. The view is
wonderful
from here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I... um... well...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hey now, Spe. Don't hold out on us. Get
on over
here!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You're going to want to remember this
race.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Guaranteed. ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: ...Now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
My resurrection from burnt ash is
complete. All
that remains is to spread
my wings and fly.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'll soar past the Otherworldly
Front-Runner and
the Phantom Bird, all
the way to the top.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I am Грасс Вандер, the
Phoenix—nothing can
hold me back!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Grass! I've been waitin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hello, El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... What happened to your usual
battle cry?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Don't need words anymore, not here!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Everything's on the line! So don't hold
back!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
